scripts.env: doppler secrets download --no-file --format env --project inversa --config ${INVERSA_DOPPLER_CONFIG:-dev} > .env && chmod 600 .env && echo "wrote .env ($(grep -c '=' .env) secrets, git-ignored)"
scripts.dev:kill: pkill -f 'bun scripts/dev.ts'; for p in ${INVERSA_WEB_PORT:-3050} ${INVERSA_API_PORT:-4041} ${INVERSA_SIGNAL_PORT:-8799}; do lsof -ti tcp:$p -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill 2>/dev/null; done; true
scripts.api: INVERSA_DATA_DIR=${INVERSA_DATA_DIR:-./data} sh -c 'if command -v doppler >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ "$INVERSA_DOPPLER" != off ]; then exec doppler run --project inversa --config ${INVERSA_DOPPLER_CONFIG:-dev} -- cargo run -q --release --manifest-path api/Cargo.toml; elif [ -f .env ]; then echo "doppler not used; loading .env"; set -a; . ./.env; set +a; exec cargo run -q --release --manifest-path api/Cargo.toml; else exec cargo run -q --release --manifest-path api/Cargo.toml; fi'
scripts.data: for a in carp lionfish python; do INVERSA_DATA_DIR=${INVERSA_DATA_DIR:-./data} cargo run -q --release --manifest-path api/Cargo.toml -- backfill --app $a --days ${DAYS:-30} || exit 1; done && INVERSA_DATA_DIR=${INVERSA_DATA_DIR:-./data} cargo run -q --release --manifest-path api/Cargo.toml -- backfill --app python --scene cold-snap-2026-02-01
scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/web build && cargo build --release --manifest-path api/Cargo.toml
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run test:api && echo CHECK-OK
